output.summary: An ornamental plant from Latin America. Its large heart- or lance-shaped leaves have striking green, white, pink and red blotches. All parts are poisonous if eaten, causing mouth burning and swelling, nausea, vomiting and diarrhoea.
output.edibilityNote: All parts are poisonous; ingestion can cause mouth burning and swelling, nausea, vomiting and diarrhoea.
